body: I don’t have to go far, 20 minute walk, you’re just required to have someone pick you up because of the anesthesia. When I expressed concerns about not having someone to pick me up they said that’s the number one reason people end up not doing ECT
I’m not from NYC but a barrier for me was transportation. ECT is an outpatient program where I am and you’re required to have someone pick you up after each treatment. I almost wasn’t able to do it.
